successCriteria.description: The three private date-helper methods (private periodContaining, private startOfUtcDay, private addMonths) are fully removed from LeaveService, so `grep -rn "private addMonths\|private startOfUtcDay\|private periodContaining" src/modules/leave/` returns nothing.

leave.service.ts imports startOfUtcDay, addMonths, and periodContaining from '../../shared/date' (the public entry point), and every former `this.` call site in cancel() and resolveBalance() now calls the imported helpers without the `this.` prefix.
`npm run build` completes cleanly and the existing unit suite passes unchanged, proving the move is behaviour-preserving and introduces no new module dependency.

constraints: Edit ONLY src/modules/leave/leave.service.ts. Do not modify the shared module, repositories, routes, DTOs, or any other file.

This is a pure move: the arithmetic and error semantics must not change. The shared helpers are used as-is (byte-for-byte identical bodies, including the ConflictError guards, the 10_000 safety bound, and the final ConflictError('Unable to resolve accrual period')).
Do not touch the unrelated `../leave-type` import (it lives in balance.service.ts and belongs to Phase 2).
outOfScope: Deduplicating balance.service.ts's private addMonths (Phase 2) and the `../leave-type` import.
Adding the deduplication pin test (Phase 3) and any change to the shared date module or its tests.
Any arithmetic, logic, or error-semantics change to the date helpers themselves.

consistencyRequirements.requirement: The imported helpers must be the canonical shared implementations re-exported from src/shared/date/index.ts (startOfUtcDay, addMonths, periodContaining), whose bodies are byte-for-byte identical to the deleted private methods.

The call sites must preserve the exact arguments and semantics of the deleted private methods: cancel() uses startOfUtcDay(request.startDate) and startOfUtcDay(new Date()); resolveBalance() uses periodContaining(employee.hireDate, policy.accrualPeriodMonths, date).

The shared helpers must continue to throw ConflictError for the same conditions (date precedes anchor; unable to resolve accrual period), preserving the existing error contract consumed by cancel() and resolveBalance().

integrationPoints.why: LeaveService now depends on the canonical shared date helpers instead of its private copies; leave -> shared-date is an allowed dependency per the reconciled architecture.
